the apoptotic process is differentially activated according to glomerulus size in diabetic nephropathy.
the apoptosis of podocytes and proximal tubular epithelial cells occurs differentially in diabetic nephropathy (DN), and the apoptosis of podocyes is more prominent in DN than proximal tubular cells.
the apoptosis of glomerular cells occurs differentially depending on the glomerular size.
